The target gains +2 size bonus to Strength, -2 size penalty to Dexterity (minimum 1), and -1 on attack rolls and AC. A creature becoming Large gains 10-foot space and reach. Speed is unchanged. If space is insufficient, the creature grows to maximum possible size and may Strength check to burst enclosures. Equipment enlarges with the creature; weapons deal increased damage but other magical properties are unchanged. Enlarged items leaving possession return to normal size. Multiple size-increasing effects do not stack. Counters and dispels reduce person. Can be made permanent with permanency. Material Component: A pinch of powdered iron.

Enlarge Person, Mass.description: This functions like enlarge person, except it affects multiple creatures.

Entangle.description: Plants in the area wrap around creatures, holding them fast. Entangled creatures can break free with a full-round DC 20 Strength or Escape Artist check to move at half speed. A successful Reflex save avoids entanglement but still limits movement to half speed. Each round on your turn, plants attempt to re-entangle freed creatures.

Enthrall.description: By speaking or singing without interruption for 1 full round, you hold a group's undivided attention. Affected creatures take no action while you perform (up to 1 hour) and for 1d3 rounds after. Those of unfriendly races or religions get +4 on the save. Creatures with 4+ HD or Wisdom 16+ remain aware with an indifferent attitude and can save again upon witnessing opposed actions. Hostile audience members can collectively Charisma check to end the spell. Any attack on an audience member ends the spell and turns previously enthralled members unfriendly (those with 4+ HD or Wisdom 16+ become hostile).

Entropic Shield.description: A multicolored chaotic field surrounds you, deflecting ranged attacks requiring attack rolls (arrows, rays, etc.) with a 20% miss chance. Attacks that simply work at a distance (like breath weapons) are unaffected.

Erase.description: You remove magical or mundane writing from a scroll or one to two pages. Can remove explosive runes, glyphs of warding, sepia snake sigils, and arcane marks, but not illusory script or symbol spells. Mundane writing is automatically erased if touched and unheld; otherwise 90% chance. Magic writing requires touching and a caster level check (1d20 + CL) against DC 15 (natural 1 or 2 always fails). Failing to erase explosive runes, glyphs, or sepia snake sigils activates them.

Ethereal Jaunt.description: You become ethereal along with your equipment. You are invisible, insubstantial, and can move in any direction at half speed, passing through solid objects. You can see and hear the Material Plane (limited to 60 feet) but everything appears gray. Force effects and abjurations affect you normally. You cannot attack material creatures, and your spells affect only ethereal things. Ending the spell while inside a solid object shunts you to the nearest open space for 1d6 damage per 5 feet traveled.

Etherealness.description: This functions like ethereal jaunt, except you and other willing creatures joined by linked hands (plus equipment) become ethereal. You can bring one creature per three caster levels. Subjects need not stay together and return to material existence when the spell expires.

Evard's Black Tentacles.description: Rubbery black tentacles, each 10 feet long, spring from the ground throughout the area. They grasp and crush creatures. Each creature in the area must make a grapple check opposed by the tentacles (treated as a Large creature with base attack bonus equal to your caster level and Strength 19, giving grapple modifier of your CL + 8). Tentacles are immune to damage and deal 1d6+4 bludgeoning per round to grappled opponents. Even ungrappled creatures move at only half speed. Material Component: A piece of giant octopus or squid tentacle.

Expeditious Retreat.description: Your base land speed increases by 30 feet (enhancement bonus). Other movement modes are unaffected. This affects jumping distance normally.

Explosive Runes.description: You inscribe runes on a written object that detonate when read, dealing 6d6 force damage. Anyone close enough to read takes full damage (no save); creatures within 10 feet get a Reflex save for half. The object takes full damage. You and designated readers are immune. Others can remove them with dispel magic or erase, but a failed attempt triggers detonation. These are magical traps (Search and Disable Device DC 28, rogue only).

Eyebite.description: Each round, you target one living creature with waves of dark power. Effects depend on HD and are cumulative: Sickened (-2 penalty on attacks, damage, saves, skill and ability checks) for 10 minutes per caster level (remove curse effective). Panicked for 1d4 rounds, then shaken for 10 minutes per caster level with automatic panic if you come into sight. Comatose for 10 minutes per caster level (not sleep, so elves are not immune). The spell lasts 1 round per three levels; targeting a new foe after the first round requires a move action.

Fabricate.description: You convert raw material into a finished product of the same substance. Complex items require appropriate Craft checks. Mineral targets are reduced to 1 cubic foot per level instead of 10. Creatures and magic items cannot be created. Casting takes 1 round per 10 cubic feet affected. Material Component: The original material at the cost of raw materials.

Faerie Fire.description: A pale glow outlines subjects, shedding candlelight illumination. Outlined creatures lose concealment from darkness (though 2nd+ level magical darkness still works), blur, displacement, invisibility, and similar effects. The light is too dim to affect light-sensitive creatures. You choose blue, green, or violet. No harm is dealt.

False Life.description: You harness negative energy to gain 1d10 + 1 per caster level (maximum +10) temporary hit points. Material Component: A small amount of alcohol or spirits used to trace sigils on your body.

False Vision.description: Any scrying directed at the area instead receives a false image you define at casting. You can concentrate to change the image; otherwise it remains static. Arcane Material Component: Jade dust worth at least 250 gp.

Fear.description: An invisible cone of terror causes living creatures in the area to become panicked (cowering if cornered) unless they succeed on a Will save, in which case they are shaken for 1 round. Material Component: A hen's heart or white feather.

Feather Fall.description: Affected creatures or objects fall at only 60 feet per round and take no landing damage while the spell lasts. Normal falling resumes when it expires. Affects Medium or smaller creatures and objects, with larger ones counting as multiples. Can be cast as a free action (like a quickened spell), even when it is not your turn. Falling objects deal half normal weight-based damage with no height bonus.

Feeblemind.description: On a failed Will save, the target's Intelligence and Charisma drop to 1. It cannot use Intelligence- or Charisma-based skills, cast spells, understand language, or communicate coherently, but still recognizes friends. Only heal, limited wish, miracle, or wish can restore it. Arcane spellcasters take -4 on the save. Material Component: A handful of clay, crystal, glass, or mineral spheres.

Find Traps.description: You gain the ability to use Search to detect traps as a rogue does, plus an insight bonus equal to half your caster level (maximum +10) on Search checks for traps. This does not grant trap-disabling ability.

Find the Path.description: The recipient can determine the shortest physical route to a specified location, even inside a maze spell. It works with locations, not creatures or objects. The spell indicates the correct direction and appropriate actions (detecting trip wires, passwords, etc.). It can extract subjects from a maze spell in one round. Focus: A set of divination counters.

Finger of Death.description: You can kill one living creature within range. A successful Fortitude save instead deals 3d6 + 1 per caster level (maximum +25) damage. The creature may still die from the damage.

Fire Seeds.description: Two versions. Acorn Grenades: Up to four acorns become splash weapons (100-foot range, ranged touch attack), dividing 1d6 fire damage per caster level (maximum 20d6) among them. Each explodes on hitting a hard surface, dealing splash damage of 1 per die and igniting combustibles within 10 feet. Direct hits allow no save. Holly Berry Bombs: Up to eight berries become bombs placed by hand (5-foot toss). On your command word (within 200 feet), each bursts for 1d8 + 1 per caster level fire damage in a 5-foot radius, igniting combustibles. Reflex save for half.

Fire Shield.description: Flames wreathe you, damaging melee attackers for 1d6 + 1 per caster level (maximum +15) while protecting you from either fire or cold. Warm Shield: Half cold damage, no damage on successful Reflex saves. Attackers take fire damage. Chill Shield: Half fire damage, no damage on successful Reflex saves. Attackers take cold damage. Reach weapons are exempt from the retaliatory damage. Arcane Material Component: Phosphorus (warm) or a firefly/glowworm (chill).

Fire Storm.description: Sheets of roaring flame fill the entire area, dealing 1d6 fire damage per caster level (maximum 20d6) to all creatures. Natural vegetation, ground cover, and plant creatures you wish to exclude are unharmed.

Fire Trap.description: You set a fiery trap on any object that can be opened. When someone other than you opens it, a 5-foot-radius explosion deals 1d4 + 1 per caster level (maximum +20) fire damage. The protected object is unharmed. Cannot stack with other closure wards. Knock does not bypass it. Failed dispel magic does not trigger it. This is a magical trap (Search and Disable Device DC 27 druid, DC 29 arcane, rogue only). Material Component: Half-pound of gold dust (25 gp).

Fireball.description: A pea-sized bead streaks from your finger and explodes into a 20-foot-radius burst, dealing 1d6 fire damage per caster level (maximum 10d6). Unattended objects also take damage. Narrow passages require ranged touch attacks to navigate. Sets fire to combustibles and melts low-melting-point metals. If the blast breaks through a barrier, it continues if range allows. Material Component: A tiny ball of bat guano and sulfur.

Flame Arrow.description: You transform ammunition into fiery projectiles, each dealing an extra 1d6 fire damage. They ignite flammable objects and structures but not creatures. Material Component: A drop of oil and a small piece of flint.

Flame Blade.description: A 3-foot blazing beam of fire springs from your hand. You wield it as a scimitar using melee touch attacks, dealing 1d8 + 1 per two caster levels (maximum +10) fire damage. Strength does not apply since the blade is immaterial. It can ignite combustibles. Does not function underwater.

Flame Strike.description: A vertical column of divine fire deals 1d6 damage per caster level (maximum 15d6). Half is fire damage; the other half is divine power and not subject to fire resistance or protection.

Flaming Sphere.description: A burning 2-foot globe rolls where you direct at 30 feet per round, ascending or jumping up to 30 feet. It deals 2d6 fire damage (Reflex negates) to creatures whose space it enters. It rolls over low barriers, ignites flammable materials, and illuminates like a torch. Directing it is a move action; otherwise it stays in place. It can be extinguished normally and winks out if it exceeds range. Arcane Material Component: Tallow, brimstone, and powdered iron.

Flare.description: A burst of light that dazzles one creature for 1 minute unless it succeeds on a Fortitude save. Sightless or already dazzled creatures are unaffected.

Flesh to Stone.description: The target and its equipment become a mindless, inert statue. If the statue is damaged, the subject (if restored) has similar injuries. The creature is not dead but does not appear alive to spells like deathwatch. Only flesh creatures are affected. Material Component: Lime, water, and earth.

Fly.description: The subject flies at 60 feet (40 feet in medium or heavy armor/load) with good maneuverability. Ascending costs double movement; descending is at double speed. Requires only walking-level concentration. Can charge but not run; cannot exceed maximum load plus armor. When the spell expires while airborne, the subject descends at 60 feet per round for 1d6 rounds, landing safely if it reaches the ground, otherwise falling for 1d6 per 10 feet. Dispelling causes the same gradual descent; antimagic fields do not. Arcane Focus: A wing feather.

Fog Cloud.description: A bank of fog obscures all sight (including darkvision) beyond 5 feet. Creatures within 5 feet have concealment (20% miss chance); those farther away have total concealment (50% miss chance, attacker cannot use sight). Moderate wind (11+ mph) disperses it in 4 rounds; strong wind (21+ mph) in 1 round. Does not function underwater.

Forbiddance.description: You seal an area against all planar travel (teleportation, plane shifting, astral travel, ethereal travel, and summoning). Additionally, creatures with differing alignments take damage when entering: same alignment is unaffected; one axis different deals 6d6 (Will half, SR applies); both axes different deals 12d6 (Will half, SR applies). A password can exempt creatures. Cannot be overlapped. Can only be dispelled by a caster of equal or higher level. Material Component: Holy water and incenses worth 1,500 gp + 1,500 gp per 60-foot cube (password adds 1,000 gp + 1,000 gp per cube).

Forcecage.description: An immobile, invisible prison of force bars or solid walls. Creatures inside are trapped unless too large. Teleportation allows escape, but the bars/walls extend to the Ethereal Plane. Resists dispel magic; vulnerable to disintegrate, sphere of annihilation, and rod of cancellation. Barred Cage: 20-foot cube with half-inch bars and gaps; tiny creatures can escape, spells pass through. Windowless Cell: 10-foot cube with solid walls. Material Component: Ruby dust worth 1,500 gp.

Foresight.description: You or another creature gains instantaneous warnings of impending danger, including sneak attacks, ambushes, and targeted spells. The subject is never surprised or flat-footed and gains a +2 insight bonus to AC and Reflex saves (lost when Dexterity bonus would be lost). When cast on another, you receive the warnings but must communicate them for the subject to benefit (the subject does not gain the AC/Reflex bonus). Arcane Material Component: A hummingbird feather.

Fox's Cunning.description: The target gains a +4 enhancement bonus to Intelligence. Intelligence-based spellcasters gain increased save DCs but not extra spells or skill points. Arcane Material Component: Fox hair or dung.

Fox's Cunning, Mass.description: This functions like fox's cunning, except it affects multiple creatures.

Freedom.description: The subject is freed from binding, entangle, grappling, imprisonment, maze, paralysis, petrification, pinning, sleep, slow, stunning, temporal stasis, and web. Freeing from imprisonment or maze requires knowing the creature's name and background and casting at the original site.

Freedom of Movement.description: The subject moves and attacks normally despite movement-impeding magic like paralysis, solid fog, slow, and web. It automatically succeeds on grapple checks to resist or escape grapples and pins. It also attacks and moves normally underwater with melee weapons. Does not grant water breathing. Material Component: A leather thong bound around an appendage.

Gaseous Form.description: The subject and gear become insubstantial, misty, and translucent. Material armor becomes worthless (size, Dexterity, deflection, and force armor bonuses still apply). The subject gains DR 10/magic, immunity to poison and critical hits, but cannot attack or cast spells with verbal, somatic, material, or focus components. It loses supernatural abilities, flies at 10 feet (perfect), and can pass through tiny openings. It is subject to wind, cannot enter water, and cannot manipulate objects. Continuous items remain active. Arcane Material Component: Gauze and a wisp of smoke.

Gate.description: Two effects: creating an interplanar portal and calling creatures. Planar Travel: Opens a circular portal (5-20 feet) between planes. Deities can prevent gates in their domains. Anyone stepping through is transported. Cannot open to the same plane. You can hold it open 1 round per level with concentration. Calling Creatures: Names a specific being or kind to pull through willingly or unwillingly (deities/unique beings are not compelled). Controlling creatures requires their HD not to exceed twice your caster level. Uncontrolled beings act freely. Controlled creatures can perform immediate tasks (1 round/level) for free, or longer contractual service for fair payment. XP Cost: 1,000 XP (calling only).

Geas, Lesser.description: You place a magical command on a creature of 7 or fewer HD that understands you. The creature must follow instructions until completed or for one day per caster level for open-ended tasks. Suicidal commands are prohibited. Disobedience for 24 hours imposes -2 to all ability scores, accumulating daily to -8 (minimum score 1). Penalties clear 24 hours after resuming compliance. Removable by break enchantment, limited wish, remove curse, miracle, or wish. Dispel magic is ineffective.

Geas/quest.description: This functions like lesser geas, except it affects any HD creature with no saving throw. Instead of ability penalties, the subject takes 3d6 damage daily and must Fortitude save or become sickened. Effects end 24 hours after resuming compliance. Remove curse works only if the caster's level is at least two higher than yours. Break enchantment is ineffective; limited wish, miracle, and wish work.

Gentle Repose.description: You preserve a corpse from decay, extending the time limit for raising the dead. Days under this spell do not count against that limit. Also works on severed body parts. Arcane Material Component: Salt and a copper piece per eye.

Ghost Sound.description: You create a volume of sound that can move or remain fixed. You choose the type at casting and cannot change its basic character. Volume scales with level: up to four humans per caster level (maximum twenty). Can produce any sound type within the volume limit. Enhances silent image. Can be made permanent with permanency. Material Component: Wool or wax.

Ghoul Touch.description: A successful melee touch attack paralyzes a living humanoid for the spell's duration. The paralyzed subject also exudes a carrion stench in a 10-foot radius that sickens living creatures (Fortitude negates). Neutralize poison removes the sickness; poison-immune creatures are unaffected by the stench. Material Component: Cloth from a ghoul or earth from a ghoul's lair.

Giant Vermin.description: You enlarge normal-sized vermin (three centipedes, two spiders, or one scorpion) into giant forms. Only one type per casting, all grown to the same size based on your level. The giant vermin do not attack you but follow only simple commands. Complex orders are beyond their comprehension. Without commands, they attack nearby creatures. The GM may extend the spell to other vermin types.

Glibness.description: You gain a +30 bonus on Bluff checks to convince others of your words' truth (not for feinting, diversion, or innuendo). Lie-detecting magical effects must succeed on a caster level check (1d20 + CL) against DC 15 + your caster level to function against you.

Glitterdust.description: Golden particles cover everything in the area, blinding creatures and outlining invisible things. The dust cannot be removed and imposes a -40 penalty on Hide checks. Material Component: Ground mica.

Globe of Invulnerability.description: This functions like lesser globe of invulnerability, except it also excludes 4th-level spells and spell-like effects.

Globe of Invulnerability, Lesser.description: An immobile magical sphere surrounds you, excluding all spell effects of 3rd level or lower. Such spells fail against targets within the globe. Spell-like abilities and item effects are also excluded. Spells of 4th level and higher, and spells already active when the globe is cast, are unaffected. Spells can be cast through or out of the globe. A targeted dispel magic can bring it down, but area dispel cannot. Use the caster's appropriate spell level to determine exclusion. Material Component: A glass or crystal bead.

Glyph of Warding.description: A powerful inscription that harms intruders entering, passing, or opening the warded area or object. You set conditions including passwords, physical characteristics, creature types, or alignment. Multiple glyphs cannot be placed on the same area. Nearly invisible once complete, detectable only by read magic (DC 13 Spellcraft), and cannot be physically probed. Blast Glyph: 1d8 per two caster levels (maximum 5d8) of chosen energy type (acid, cold, fire, electricity, or sonic) in a 5-foot radius (Reflex half, SR applies). Spell Glyph: Stores a harmful spell of 3rd level or lower. Magical trap (DC 28, rogue only). Material Component: Incense and powdered diamond worth at least 200 gp.

Glyph of Warding, Greater.description: This functions like glyph of warding, except the blast glyph deals up to 10d8 and the spell glyph stores up to 6th-level spells. Material Component: Incense and powdered diamond worth at least 400 gp.

Good Hope.description: Subjects gain a +2 morale bonus on saving throws, attack rolls, ability checks, skill checks, and weapon damage rolls. Counters and dispels crushing despair.

Goodberry.description: You make 2d4 freshly picked berries magical. Each provides one full meal's nourishment for a Medium creature and heals 1 hp when eaten, to a maximum of 8 hp per 24-hour period.

Grease.description: A slippery coating covers a solid surface or object. Creatures in the area must Reflex save or fall, repeating each round. Walking through requires a DC 10 Balance check at half speed. On an object, the wielder gets a Reflex save; failure drops the item, with saves each round to pick it up. Greased armor/clothing grants +10 to Escape Artist and grapple escape checks. Material Component: Pork rind or butter.

Guards and Wards.description: A comprehensive defense for your stronghold (200 sq ft/level, up to 20 feet high). Creates: fog obscuring vision; arcane locks on all doors; regenerating webs on stairs; 50% directional confusion at intersections; one hidden door per caster level; plus one chosen effect from: dancing lights, magic mouth, stinking cloud, gust of wind, or suggestion. A successful specific dispel magic removes only that effect. Mordenkainen's disjunction destroys the entire ward. Material Component: Incense, brimstone, oil, knotted string, and blood. Focus: A small silver rod.

Guidance.description: The subject gains a +1 competence bonus on a single attack roll, saving throw, or skill check, chosen before rolling.

Gust of Wind.description: A severe blast of air (~50 mph) from you affects all creatures in its path. Tiny or smaller ground creatures are knocked down and rolled 1d4x10 feet (1d4 nonlethal per 10 feet); flying ones are blown back 2d6x10 feet (2d6 nonlethal). Small creatures are knocked prone or blown back 1d6x10 feet. Medium creatures cannot advance or are blown back 1d6x5 feet. Large+ creatures are unaffected. All creatures take -4 on ranged attacks and Listen checks. Extinguishes candles and torches; 50% chance of extinguishing lanterns. Can be made permanent with permanency.

Hallow.description: You consecrate a site with four effects: magic circle against evil, +4 sacred bonus on turn checks (-4 to command), dead interred cannot become undead, and one fixed spell effect lasting one year throughout the site (designating who is affected). Spells that can be fixed include aid, bane, bless, cause fear, darkness, daylight, death ward, and many others. Only one hallow per area. Counters but does not dispel unhallow. Material Component: Herbs, oils, and incense worth 1,000 gp + 1,000 gp per spell level.

Hallucinatory Terrain.description: Natural terrain appears as a different type of natural terrain (fields as swamp, pond as meadow, etc.). Structures, equipment, and creatures are not disguised. Material Component: A stone, twig, and green plant.

Halt Undead.description: Up to three undead are rendered immobile. Mindless undead get no save; intelligent undead do. The effect is similar to hold person and breaks if the halted creatures are attacked or take damage. Material Component: Sulfur and powdered garlic.

Harm.description: You charge a subject with negative energy dealing 10 points per caster level (maximum 150 at 15th). A successful save halves the damage, but cannot reduce hp below 1. Against undead, it acts like heal.

Haste.description: Transmuted creatures gain: one extra attack per round at full base attack bonus during full attacks (not cumulative with similar effects); +1 on attack rolls; +1 dodge bonus to AC and Reflex saves; +30 feet to all movement modes (maximum double normal speed, counts as enhancement bonus). Multiple haste effects do not stack. Counters and dispels slow. Material Component: Licorice root shaving.

Heal.description: You channel positive energy to eliminate injury and afflictions, immediately ending: ability damage, blindness, confusion, daze, dazzle, deafness, disease, exhaustion, fatigue, feeblemind, insanity, nausea, sickness, stunning, and poison. It also restores 10 hp per caster level (maximum 150). Does not remove negative levels or permanently drained attributes. Against undead, it acts like harm.

Heal Mount.description: This functions like heal, except it affects only the paladin's special mount.

Heal, Mass.description: This functions like heal, except it affects multiple creatures with a maximum of 250 hp restored to each.

Heat Metal.description: You make metal extremely hot. Nonmagical, unattended metal gets no save. Magical metal and items in a creature's possession use the higher save bonus. A creature takes fire damage based on contact with heated metal: full damage if wearing affected armor or carrying metal weighing at least one-fifth its weight, minimum damage otherwise. Damage progresses over rounds: none on rounds 1 and 7, moderate on rounds 2 and 6, searing on rounds 3-5. Cold damage offsets fire damage point-for-point. Underwater, deals half damage and boils surrounding water. Counters and dispels chill metal.

Helping Hand.description: You create a ghostly hand that seeks a creature within 5 miles matching your physical description. Once found, it beckons the creature to follow, pointing toward you at up to 240 feet per round. The creature is not compelled to follow. If the creature refuses, the hand beckons until the spell ends. If not found within 4 hours, the hand returns displaying an empty palm. The hand is invisible to others, has no physical form, and cannot pass through solid objects.

Heroes' Feast.description: A magnificent feast takes 1 hour to consume. Afterward, each participant is cured of all diseases, sickness, and nausea; becomes immune to poison for 12 hours; gains 1d8 + 1 per two caster levels (maximum +10) temporary hit points; and gains a +1 morale bonus on attack rolls and Will saves plus immunity to fear for 12 hours. Interrupting the feast ruins all effects.

Heroism.description: The target gains a +2 morale bonus on attack rolls, saves, and skill checks.

Heroism, Greater.description: This functions like heroism, except it grants a +4 morale bonus on attack rolls, saves, and skill checks, immunity to fear, and temporary hit points equal to your caster level (maximum 20).

Hide from Animals.description: Animals cannot perceive warded creatures through any sense, including extraordinary and supernatural abilities like blindsense, blindsight, scent, and tremorsense. Ends for all recipients if any warded creature touches an animal or attacks.

Hide from Undead.description: Undead cannot perceive warded creatures through any sense. Mindless undead are automatically affected. Intelligent undead get one Will save; failure means they cannot detect any warded creature but may attempt to find them if suspicious. Ends for all if any warded creature turns/commands undead, touches undead, or attacks.

Hold Animal.description: This functions like hold person, except it affects an animal.

Hold Monster.description: This functions like hold person, except it affects any living creature. Arcane Material Component: A hard metal bar or rod.

Hold Monster, Mass.description: This functions like hold person, except it affects multiple creatures and can hold any living creature.

Hold Person.description: The target is paralyzed in place, aware and breathing but unable to take any actions including speech. Each round on its turn, it may attempt a new save (full-round action, no opportunity attacks). A paralyzed flying creature falls, and a swimmer may drown. Arcane Focus: A small straight piece of iron.

Hold Person, Mass.description: This functions like hold person, except it affects multiple creatures.

Hold Portal.description: You magically hold shut a door, gate, window, or shutter of wood, metal, or stone as if securely closed and locked. Knock or dispel magic negates it. Add 5 to the normal DC to force the portal open.

Holy Aura.description: Brilliant divine radiance provides four effects: +4 deflection to AC and +4 resistance on saves against all attacks; SR 25 against evil spells and spells cast by evil creatures; blocks possession and mental influence; evil creatures making successful melee attacks are blinded (Fortitude negates). Focus: A tiny reliquary with a sacred relic, costing at least 500 gp.

Holy Smite.description: Holy power strikes enemies in the area. Evil creatures take 1d8 per two caster levels (maximum 5d8, or 1d6 per caster level maximum 10d6 for evil outsiders) and are blinded for 1 round (Will halves damage, negates blindness). Neutral creatures take half damage with no blindness (Will halves again). Good creatures are unaffected.

Holy Sword.description: Your melee weapon becomes a +5 holy weapon (+5 enhancement, extra 2d6 against evil) and emits a magic circle against evil that regenerates on your turn if ended. Cancels automatically 1 round after leaving your hand. Supersedes the weapon's normal properties for the duration. Not cumulative with other weapon-enhancing spells. Does not affect artifacts.

Holy Word.description: Nongood creatures hearing the holy word suffer cumulative effects with no save based on HD relative to your caster level: deafened 1d4 rounds, blinded 2d4 rounds, paralyzed 1d10 minutes, killed (living die, undead destroyed). Nongood extraplanar creatures on your home plane are banished for at least 24 hours (Will at -4 negates). Creatures with HD exceeding your caster level are unaffected.

Horrid Wilting.description: Moisture evaporates from each living creature's body, dealing 1d6 damage per caster level (maximum 20d6). Water elementals and plant creatures take 1d8 per caster level (maximum 20d8) instead. Arcane Material Component: A bit of sponge.

Hypnotic Pattern.description: A shifting pattern of colors fascinates creatures within it. Roll 2d4 + caster level (maximum 10) to determine total HD affected, with fewest HD affected first. Fascinated creatures are captivated. Sightless creatures are unaffected. Material Component: Glowing incense or a phosphorescent crystal rod.

Hypnotism.description: Your gestures and droning fascinate nearby creatures. Roll 2d4 for total HD affected (fewest first). Combat targets get +2 on saves; a single non-combat target takes -2. Fascinated subjects react as two steps more friendly, allowing one brief, reasonable request. After the spell, the creature retains the new attitude regarding that request. Affected creatures do not remember being enchanted.

Ice Storm.description: Magical hailstones pound for 1 full round, dealing 3d6 bludgeoning and 2d6 cold damage. Listen checks take -4, and land movement is halved. The hail disappears afterward, leaving only damage dealt. Arcane Material Component: Dust and a few drops of water.

Identify.description: You determine all magical properties of a single magic item, including activation methods and remaining charges. Does not function on artifacts. Arcane Material Component: A pearl worth at least 100 gp, crushed and mixed with wine and an owl feather, drunk before casting.

Illusory Script.description: You write information that only designated readers can understand. Others see foreign or magical writing. Unauthorized readers who attempt to read it trigger an illusory effect (save or be subject to a suggestion you implanted, lasting 30 minutes). Dispel magic destroys both the illusion and the secret message. True seeing combined with read magic or comprehend languages reveals the hidden text. Material Component: Lead-based ink worth at least 50 gp.

Illusory Wall.description: You create a realistic illusion of a wall, floor, ceiling, or similar surface. Physical objects pass through it. Non-sight detection works normally. Touch or probing reveals the illusion but does not dismiss it.

Imbue With Spell Ability.description: You transfer prepared cleric spells (abjuration, divination, or conjuration healing only) to a creature with Intelligence 5+ and Wisdom 9+. The number and level depend on the recipient's HD. Transferred spells use your caster level. You cannot prepare a new 4th-level spell to replace this one until the recipient uses the imbued spells, dies, or you dismiss the effect.

Implosion.description: Each round you concentrate, one corporeal creature collapses in on itself and dies (instantaneous, cannot be dispelled). Each creature can only be targeted once per casting. No effect on gaseous or incorporeal creatures.

Imprisonment.description: You touch a creature, entombing it in suspended animation in a small sphere deep beneath the earth. Only freedom cast at the imprisonment site can release it. Divination cannot detect it except discern location. Wish or miracle reveals the location but cannot free the subject. Knowing the target's name and background imposes -4 on its save.

Incendiary Cloud.description: Roiling smoke with white-hot embers obscures sight as fog cloud and deals 4d6 fire damage per round (Reflex half). The cloud moves away at 10 feet per round, or you can direct it up to 60 feet per round with concentration. Wind disperses it; cannot be cast underwater.

Inflict Critical Wounds.description: This functions like inflict light wounds, except it deals 4d8 + 1 per caster level (maximum +20).

Inflict Critical Wounds, Mass.description: This functions like mass inflict light wounds, except it deals 4d8 + 1 per caster level (maximum +40).

Inflict Light Wounds.description: You channel negative energy through your touch, dealing 1d8 + 1 per caster level (maximum +5) damage. Against undead, this heals instead.

Inflict Light Wounds, Mass.description: Negative energy spreads from the origin point, dealing 1d8 + 1 per caster level (maximum +25) to nearby living enemies. Undead in the area are healed instead.

Inflict Minor Wounds.description: This functions like inflict light wounds, except it deals 1 point of damage and a Will save negates completely.

Inflict Moderate Wounds.description: This functions like inflict light wounds, except it deals 2d8 + 1 per caster level (maximum +10).

Inflict Moderate Wounds, Mass.description: This functions like mass inflict light wounds, except it deals 2d8 + 1 per caster level (maximum +30).

Inflict Serious Wounds.description: This functions like inflict light wounds, except it deals 3d8 + 1 per caster level (maximum +15).

Inflict Serious Wounds, Mass.description: This functions like mass inflict light wounds, except it deals 3d8 + 1 per caster level (maximum +35).

Insanity.description: The target suffers permanent confusion (as the spell). Remove curse is ineffective. Greater restoration, heal, limited wish, miracle, or wish can cure it.

Insect Plague.description: You summon locust swarms (one per three levels, maximum six at 18th), which must be placed adjacent to form a contiguous area. They attack creatures in their space. The swarms are stationary and do not pursue fleeing creatures.

Invisibility.description: The touched creature or object vanishes from sight, even from darkvision. Carried gear also vanishes. Dropped items become visible; picked-up items disappear. Light sources become invisible but still shed light. Items extending more than 10 feet from the subject become visible. The spell ends if the subject attacks (including targeting foes with spells). Indirect harm does not end it. Can be made permanent on objects with permanency. Arcane Material Component: An eyelash in gum arabic.

Invisibility Purge.description: A sphere with 5-foot radius per caster level negates all invisibility within it.

Invisibility Sphere.description: This functions like invisibility, except it affects all creatures within 10 feet of the recipient. Affected creatures can see each other. Leaving the area ends the effect for that creature; entering after casting does not grant invisibility. Non-recipient attackers only break their own invisibility. If the recipient attacks, the entire sphere ends.

Invisibility, Greater.description: This functions like invisibility, except attacking does not end the effect.

Invisibility, Mass.description: This functions like invisibility, except the effect is mobile with the group and breaks for anyone who attacks. Individuals cannot see each other. The effect ends for anyone moving more than 180 feet from the nearest group member. Material Component: An eyelash in gum arabic.

Iron Body.description: Your body becomes living iron, granting DR 15/adamantine, immunity to blindness, critical hits, ability damage, deafness, disease, drowning, electricity, poison, stunning, and physiology-affecting effects. You take half damage from acid and fire but are vulnerable to iron golem weaknesses. You gain +6 Strength but take -6 Dexterity (minimum 1), half speed, 50% arcane spell failure, and -8 armor check penalty. Cannot drink or play wind instruments. Unarmed attacks deal club damage and count as armed. Weight increases tenfold. Arcane Material Component: A piece of iron from an iron golem, hero's armor, or war machine.

Ironwood.description: You transform normal wood into a magical substance as strong, heavy, and fire-resistant as steel. Metal-affecting spells do not work on it; wood-affecting spells do. It does not burn. You can craft wooden items that function as steel equivalents, freely usable by druids. Making half the normal amount creates items with a +1 enhancement bonus. Material Component: Wood shaped into the intended form.

Jump.description: The subject gains a +10 enhancement bonus on Jump checks, increasing to +20 at caster level 5th and +30 at 9th. Material Component: A grasshopper's hind leg.

Keen Edge.description: A weapon's threat range doubles: 20 becomes 19-20, 19-20 becomes 17-20, 18-20 becomes 15-20. Only piercing or slashing weapons. Projectiles lose the effect after one use. Does not stack with other threat range increases. Cannot affect natural weapons.

Knock.description: Opens stuck, barred, locked, held, or arcane locked doors, as well as secret doors and locked containers. Loosens welds, shackles, and chains. Does not remove arcane lock (suppresses for 10 minutes). Cannot raise portcullises or affect ropes/vines. Limited by area (30 sq ft at 3rd level). Each casting undoes up to two means of prevention.

Know Direction.description: You instantly know the direction of north. Works in any environment where north exists but may fail on other planes. The knowledge is accurate only at the moment of casting.

Legend Lore.description: You learn legends about an important person, place, or thing. Casting time depends on proximity: 1d4x10 minutes if at hand, 1d10 days if you have detailed information, 2d6 weeks if only rumors. During casting, only routine activities are possible. Results range from complete to vague depending on information quality. Non-legendary subjects yield no information. Material Component: Incense worth 250 gp. Focus: Four ivory strips (50 gp each) formed into a rectangle.

Leomund's Secret Chest.description: You hide a chest (up to 1 cubic foot per caster level) on the Ethereal Plane for up to 60 days, retrievable by concentration (standard action). Living creatures inside have a 75% chance of causing failure. The chest must be exceptionally crafted (minimum 5,000 gp) with a perfect miniature replica (50 gp). After 60 days, there is a cumulative 5% daily chance of permanent loss. If the replica is lost, the chest cannot be recalled. Focus: The chest and its replica.

Leomund's Secure Shelter.description: You conjure a sturdy cottage from local materials with a door, two windows, fireplace, and eight bunks with furnishings. It is as strong as stone with arcane locked doors and shutters, an iron grate on the chimney, and alarm spells on all three. An unseen servant provides service. Material Component: Stone chip, lime, sand, water, and wood splinters.

Leomund's Tiny Hut.description: An opaque sphere of force (any color) surrounds you. Up to nine Medium creatures can share it. Temperature is maintained at 70 degrees F (adjusted 1-for-1 outside 0-100 range). Protects against elements and wind below hurricane force. Transparent from inside, opaque from outside. Missiles and spell effects pass through without affecting it, but occupants have total concealment. Ends if you leave. Material Component: A small crystal bead.

Leomund's Trap.description: A small mechanism appears trapped to anyone capable of detecting traps, who is 100% certain a real trap exists. Nothing happens if triggered. Another active trap within 50 feet prevents casting. Material Component: Iron pyrite and special dust (50 gp).

Levitate.description: You move a willing creature or unattended object up or down up to 20 feet per round (move action). No horizontal movement, though the subject can push off surfaces. Attacking while levitating incurs cumulative -1 penalties (to -5 max); a full round of stabilizing resets to -1. Focus: A small leather loop or gold wire cup.

Light.description: An object glows like a torch with 20-foot bright light and 20 more feet of dim light. A light spell counters and dispels an equal or lower-level darkness spell. Arcane Material Component: A firefly or phosphorescent moss.

Lightning Bolt.description: A stroke of electrical energy from your fingertips deals 1d6 electricity per caster level (maximum 10d6). Sets fire to combustibles and melts low-melting-point metals. Can continue past broken barriers if range allows. Material Component: Fur and an amber, crystal, or glass rod.

Limited Wish.description: You create nearly any effect, subject to limitations. XP Cost: 300 XP or more.

Liveoak.description: You transform a healthy Huge oak (within 10 feet of your dwelling, a sacred place, or 300 feet of what you wish to guard) into an animated treant-like guardian with a trigger phrase up to one word per caster level. Only one can be active at a time. If dispelled, the tree takes root immediately. If released, it returns to its original location.

Locate Creature.description: This functions like locate object, except it locates creatures. You sense direction and movement of a known or familiar creature, or a specific kind you have seen within 30 feet. Cannot find creature types. Running water blocks it. Material Component: Bloodhound fur.

Locate Object.description: You sense the direction of a well-known or clearly visualized object. You can search for general items (finding the nearest) or specific items (requiring an accurate mental image). You cannot specify a unique item without having seen it firsthand. Blocked by thin lead. Cannot locate creatures. Arcane Focus: A forked twig.

Longstrider.description: Your base land speed increases by 10 feet (enhancement bonus). Other movement modes are unaffected. Material Component: A pinch of dirt.

Lullaby.description: Creatures that fail a Will save become drowsy, taking -5 on Listen and Spot checks and -2 on Will saves against sleep effects. Lasts while you concentrate plus up to 1 round per caster level.

Mage Armor.description: An invisible field of force provides a +4 armor bonus to AC with no check penalty, spell failure, or speed reduction. Being made of force, incorporeal creatures cannot bypass it. Focus: A piece of cured leather.

Mage Hand.description: You telekinetically lift and move an object weighing up to 5 pounds, propelling it up to 15 feet per round as a move action. Ends if the object exceeds the spell's range.

Magic Circle Against Chaos.description: This functions like magic circle against evil, except it uses protection from chaos effects and can imprison nonlawful called creatures.

Magic Circle Against Evil.description: All creatures in the area gain protection from evil effects, and nongood summoned creatures cannot enter. The spell can alternatively be focused inward to bind a nongood called creature for up to 24 hours per caster level. The binding requires a circle of powdered silver; breaking it ends the effect. Trapped creatures can test spell resistance daily and escape via dimensional travel unless anchored. A special diagram (DC 20 Spellcraft, drawn in 10 minutes) increases the security, blocking spell resistance and abilities, and raising the Charisma check DC by 5. Arcane Material Component: Powdered silver for a 3-foot circle.

Magic Circle Against Good.description: This functions like magic circle against evil, except it uses protection from good effects and can imprison nonevil called creatures.

Magic Circle Against Law.description: This functions like magic circle against evil, except it uses protection from law effects and can imprison nonchaotic called creatures.

Magic Fang.description: One natural weapon gains a +1 enhancement bonus on attack and damage rolls. Can be made permanent with permanency.

Magic Fang, Greater.description: This functions like magic fang, except the bonus is +1 per four caster levels (maximum +5), or alternatively +1 to all natural weapons. Can be made permanent with permanency.

Magic Jar.description: You place your soul in a gem, leaving your body lifeless. From the gem, you can sense and attempt to possess life forces within 10 feet per caster level. Possession requires a full-round action and is blocked by protection from evil. The target gets a Will save; success means you cannot try that target again. On success, you keep your mental attributes and the host's physical ones. You cannot use the host's extraordinary or supernatural abilities. You can shift between the gem and a host as a standard action. The spell ends when you return to your own body. If the host dies in range, you return to the gem. If out of range, both die. Destroying the gem ends the spell. Focus: A gem worth at least 100 gp.

Magic Missile.description: A missile of force strikes unerringly for 1d4+1 damage, even against targets with less than total cover or concealment. You gain additional missiles at 3rd (two), 5th (three), 7th (four), and 9th level (five maximum). Multiple missiles can target one or several creatures. Targets must be designated before rolling.

Magic Mouth.description: An enchanted mouth appears on an object or creature, speaking a message of up to 25 words when specified conditions are met. It cannot use verbal components, command words, or activate magic. Triggers must be visual or audible (range 15 feet per caster level). Can be made permanent with permanency. Material Component: Honeycomb and jade dust (10 gp).

Magic Stone.description: Up to three pebbles strike with great force (+1 enhancement on attack and damage). Range increment: 20 feet thrown or 50 feet slung. Each deals 1d6+1 damage, or 2d6+2 against undead.

Magic Vestment.description: Armor or a shield gains an enhancement bonus of +1 per four caster levels (maximum +5 at 20th).

Magic Weapon.description: A weapon gains a +1 enhancement bonus on attack and damage rolls (does not stack with masterwork). Cannot affect natural weapons (use magic fang instead). Monk unarmed strikes can be enhanced.

Magic Weapon, Greater.description: This functions like magic weapon, except the bonus is +1 per four caster levels (maximum +5). Alternatively, affects up to fifty projectiles of the same kind. Projectiles lose the transmutation on use. Arcane Material Component: Powdered lime and carbon.

Major Creation.description: This functions like minor creation, except you can also create mineral objects (stone, crystal, metal). Duration varies by hardness and rarity.

Major Image.description: This functions like silent image, except it includes sound, smell, and thermal elements. While concentrating, you can move the image. It disappears when struck unless you make it react appropriately.

Make Whole.description: This functions like mending, except it completely repairs an object of any substance, even with multiple breaks. Does not restore magical abilities of broken items, mend rods/staffs/wands, or repair warped/disintegrated/melted items, nor affect creatures.

Mark of Justice.description: You draw an indelible mark on a willing or restrained subject, specifying behavior that activates a bestow curse effect. Cannot be dispelled, but removable by break enchantment, limited wish, miracle, remove curse (if caster level is equal or higher), or wish.

Maze.description: You banish the subject into an extradimensional labyrinth of force planes. Each round, it may attempt a DC 20 Intelligence check (full-round action) to escape. After 10 minutes, the maze vanishes, forcing exit. The subject reappears at its original location. Intraplanar movement spells do not help escape, but plane shift does. Minotaurs are immune.

Meld Into Stone.description: You merge into a single block of stone large enough to contain you (plus up to 100 pounds of gear). You remain aware of time, can cast spells on yourself, and can hear outside. Minor stone damage does not harm you, but partial destruction expels you for 5d6 damage. Complete destruction is instantly fatal (DC 18 Fortitude save). You can exit voluntarily through your entry surface. Forced expulsion (duration expiry or dispel) deals 5d6 damage. Stone to flesh expels for 5d6. Stone shape deals 3d6 without expelling. Transmute rock to mud expels and kills (DC 18 Fort). Passwall expels without damage.

Melf's Acid Arrow.description: A magical arrow of acid (ranged touch attack) deals 2d4 acid damage with no splash. For every three caster levels (maximum 18th), the acid persists an additional round, dealing 2d4 more each round. Material Component: Rhubarb leaf powder and an adder's stomach. Focus: A dart.

Mending.description: You repair small breaks or tears in objects (not warps). Welds single metallic breaks; ceramic or wooden objects with multiple breaks are invisibly rejoined. Completely heals holes in leather containers. Restores physical integrity of magic items but not their magical abilities. Cannot mend rods, staffs, wands, or affect creatures.

Message.description: You whisper messages to designated creatures within range, who can whisper replies. Blocked by 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of metal, thin lead, or 3 feet of wood/dirt. The message can travel around barriers via open paths within range. Transmits sound, not meaning; does not cross language barriers. Focus: Copper wire.

Meteor Swarm.description: Four 2-foot fiery spheres streak to your chosen locations. You may make ranged touch attacks against specific creatures; a direct hit deals 2d6 bludgeoning (no save) plus the sphere's fire damage (no save on the fire for direct hits). Each sphere explodes in a 40-foot radius for 6d6 fire damage (Reflex half). Creatures in multiple explosions save against each separately.

Mind Blank.description: The subject is protected from all thought-detecting, emotion-reading, and mind-affecting spells and effects, including divination. Even limited wish, miracle, and wish cannot affect the protected mind or gain information about it. Area scrying simply does not detect the subject; targeted scrying fails entirely.

Mind Fog.description: A bank of thin mist imposes -10 on Wisdom checks and Will saves (save negates; those who save are immune even if remaining). The penalty persists while in the fog and for 2d6 rounds after leaving. The fog is stationary, lasts 30 minutes, and is dispersible by moderate or strong wind. It does not significantly impair vision.

Minor Creation.description: You create a nonmagical object of nonliving vegetable matter up to 1 cubic foot per caster level. Complex items require skill checks. Created objects fail as spell material components. Material Component: A tiny piece of similar matter.

Minor Image.description: This functions like silent image, except it includes minor sounds but not understandable speech.

Miracle.description: You request divine intervention. The GM determines the effect. It can duplicate most spells and perform powerful feats. Especially powerful requests cost 5,000 XP. Duplicated spells use 9th-level save DCs. Material and XP costs of duplicated spells must be paid. XP Cost: 5,000 XP for certain uses.

Mirage Arcana.description: This functions like hallucinatory terrain, except it can alter the appearance of structures or add them. The illusion includes audible, visual, tactile, and olfactory elements. It cannot disguise or add creatures.

Mirror Image.description: 1d4 + 1 per three caster levels (maximum 8 total) illusory duplicates appear near you. Enemies must randomly select targets, potentially striking images (which are destroyed at AC 10 + size mod + Dex mod). Images mimic your actions, react to area spells, and can be merged with and split from during movement to re-confuse enemies. Invisible subjects or blind attackers negate the effect.

Misdirection.description: You redirect the aura information from detection spells to another object within range. Detection spells provide information based on the other object rather than the actual target (Will save for the detection caster to see through it). Does not affect other divination types.

Mislead.description: You become invisible (as greater invisibility) while an illusory double (as major image) appears. You can make the double appear over your body to mask the transition. The double moves at your speed with speech and gestures but cannot attack or cast. It lasts as long as you concentrate plus 3 rounds. The invisibility lasts 1 round per level regardless of concentration.

Modify Memory.description: You alter up to 5 minutes of a subject's memories. Illogical modifications are dismissed as bad dreams. Useful applications include implanting friendly encounters, changing orders, or making the subject forget your presence. The GM may judge modifications that are too nonsensical as ineffective.

Moment of Prescience.description: Once during the duration, you gain an insight bonus equal to your caster level (maximum +25) on any single attack roll, opposed check, saving throw, or AC against one attack. You must choose before rolling. Activation takes no action and can occur on another's turn. Only one can be active at a time.

Mordenkainen's Disjunction.description: All magical effects and items within the radius (except those you carry or touch) are disjoined. Spells are ended; permanent magic items must Will save or become mundane. You have a 1% chance per caster level of destroying an antimagic field. Even artifacts are subject to disjunction (1% per caster level chance), but destroying one requires a DC 25 Will save or permanent loss of all spellcasting.

Mordenkainen's Faithful Hound.description: An invisible phantom watchdog guards where it was conjured. It barks loudly if any Small+ creature approaches within 30 feet (those present at conjuration are exempt until they leave and return). It sees invisible and ethereal creatures and reacts to shadow illusions. Within 5 feet, it bites (+10 attack, 2d6+3 piercing, counts as magic weapon), ready to strike on the intruder's turn. Cannot be attacked but can be dispelled. Lasts 1 hour per level, but only 1 round per level once barking begins. Ends if you move more than 100 feet away. Material Component: A silver whistle, bone, and thread.

Mordenkainen's Lucubration.description: You instantly recall any spell of 5th level or lower that you actually cast within the past 24 hours, restoring it as though normally prepared. Material components must be provided before use.

Mordenkainen's Magnificent Mansion.description: You conjure an extradimensional dwelling with a faint shimmering entry (4x8 feet). Only those you designate may enter. Inside is a foyer with customizable chambers, furnishings, a nine-course feast for twelve per caster level, and up to two near-transparent servants per caster level (as visible unseen servants). Outside conditions do not affect the interior. Focus: A miniature ivory portal, marble piece, and silver spoon (5 gp each).

Mordenkainen's Private Sanctum.description: The area appears as dark fog from outside (darkvision cannot penetrate). No sound escapes; scrying cannot perceive inside; detect thoughts is blocked. Those inside see out normally. Does not block sending, message, or telepathy. Does not prevent physical entry/exit. Can be made permanent with permanency. Material Component: Thin lead sheet, opaque glass, cotton, and powdered chrysolite.

Mordenkainen's Sword.description: A swordlike plane of force attacks a designated target once per round with attack bonus equal to caster level + Int or Cha modifier + 3. As a force effect, it strikes ethereal and incorporeal creatures. Deals 4d6+3 force damage (threat 19-20, x2 crit). Always strikes from your direction. Redirecting is a standard action. Cannot be physically harmed; vulnerable to dispel magic, disintegrate, and similar. AC 13; spell resistance is tested on the first strike. Focus: A miniature platinum sword (250 gp).

Mount.description: You summon a light horse or pony as a mount, with bit, bridle, and riding saddle. Material Component: Horse hair.

Move Earth.description: You move dirt (clay, loam, sand) but not rock. For every 150-foot square (up to 10 feet deep), casting takes 10 minutes (maximum area: 750x750 feet, 4 hours 10 minutes). Creates wavelike changes rather than violent upheaval. Trees, structures, and rock are mostly unaffected except for elevation changes. Not suitable for tunneling or trapping creatures. Material Component: Mixed soils in a bag and an iron blade.

Neutralize Poison.description: You eliminate all venom in the creature or object touched. Future poison effects end, temporary effects cease, but past damage is not reversed. The creature is immune to new poisons for the duration. Alternatively, you can neutralize the poison in a poisonous creature or object for the duration. Arcane Material Component: A bit of charcoal.

Nightmare.description: You send a phantasmal vision to a named creature, preventing restful sleep and dealing 1d10 damage. The subject is fatigued and cannot regain arcane spells for 24 hours. Save difficulty depends on your familiarity with the subject. If the recipient is awake, you can wait in a vulnerable trance. Creatures that do not sleep or dream are immune.

Nondetection.description: The warded creature or object resists divination spells. Diviners must succeed on a caster level check against DC 11 + the nondetection caster's level (or DC 15 + CL if self-cast). Also wards the creature's gear. Material Component: Diamond dust worth 50 gp.

Nystul's Magic Aura.description: You alter an item's detected aura to appear nonmagical, as a different kind of magic item, or as under a specified spell. Identify allows a Will save to recognize the false aura. Exceptionally powerful items (artifacts) are not affected. Focus: A small silk square.

Obscure Object.description: You hide an object from location by divination (scrying) effects. Targeted divinations fail automatically; area divinations fail to perceive the object. Arcane Material Component: Chameleon skin.

Obscuring Mist.description: Stationary mist obscures all sight (including darkvision) beyond 5 feet. Creatures within 5 feet have 20% concealment; farther away have 50% (total concealment). Moderate wind disperses in 4 rounds; strong wind in 1 round. Fire spells burn away fog in their area. Does not function underwater.

Open/close.description: You open or close a container or portal (door, chest, box, etc.) weighing 30 pounds or less. Fails if anything resists (bar, lock). Focus: A brass key.

Order's Wrath.description: Lawful energy in a 3D grid harms chaotic and neutral creatures. Chaotic creatures take 1d8 per two caster levels (maximum 5d8, or 1d6/level maximum 10d6 for chaotic outsiders) and are dazed 1 round (Will halves, negates daze). Neutral creatures take half damage with no daze (Will halves again).

Otiluke's Freezing Sphere.description: A frigid globe explodes in a 10-foot radius for 1d6 cold per caster level (maximum 15d6), or 1d8 per level against water elementals. On water, it freezes 6 inches deep over 100 sq ft per caster level (max 1,500), lasting 1 round per level. You can delay firing as a held touch charge (up to 1 round per level, then it bursts centered on you). Focus: A small crystal sphere.

Otiluke's Resilient Sphere.description: A globe of force encloses a creature (if small enough). The sphere is immune to all damage except rod of cancellation, rod of negation, disintegrate, or targeted dispel magic. Nothing passes through; the subject can breathe normally but cannot physically move the sphere. Material Component: Hemispherical clear crystal and matching gum arabic.

Otiluke's Telekinetic Sphere.description: This functions like resilient sphere, except contents weigh one-sixteenth normal. You can telekinetically move the sphere (up to 5,000 lbs of contents) at 30 feet per round with concentration (standard action). Falls at 60 feet per round (no damage to contents). Material Component: Clear crystal, gum arabic, and bar magnets.

Otto's Irresistible Dance.description: The subject dances uncontrollably, taking -4 to AC, -10 to Reflex saves, losing shield AC bonus, and provoking opportunity attacks each round.

Overland Flight.description: This functions like fly, except speed is 40 feet (30 if encumbered) with average maneuverability. You can hustle without nonlethal damage, covering 64 miles in 8 hours (48 at 30 feet).

Owl's Wisdom.description: The target gains a +4 enhancement bonus to Wisdom. Wisdom-based spellcasters gain increased save DCs but not extra spells. Arcane Material Component: Owl feathers or droppings.

Owl's Wisdom, Mass.description: This functions like owl's wisdom, except it affects multiple creatures.

Pass Without Trace.description: Subjects leave no footprints or scent in any terrain. Nonmagical tracking is impossible.

Passwall.description: You create a passage through wood, plaster, or stone (not metal) that is 10 feet deep + 5 feet per three caster levels above 9th (maximum 25 feet). Multiple castings can breach thick walls. Creatures inside when it ends are ejected from the nearest exit. Material Component: Sesame seeds.

Permanency.description: You make certain spells permanent. Some work only on yourself (dispellable only by higher-level casters); others work on creatures, objects, or areas (dispellable normally). Each application requires a minimum caster level and XP expenditure. The GM may allow additional spells to be made permanent through research. XP Cost: Varies.

Permanent Image.description: This functions like silent image, except it includes visual, auditory, olfactory, and thermal elements and is permanent. You can move the image with concentration; otherwise it is static. Material Component: Fleece and jade dust (100 gp).

Persistent Image.description: This functions like silent image, except it includes visual, auditory, olfactory, and thermal elements and follows a script you define without requiring concentration. Can include intelligible speech. Material Component: Fleece and sand grains.

Phantasmal Killer.description: You create the most fearsome creature imaginable to the target from its own subconscious fears. Only the target sees it. A failed Will save means the phantasm touches the subject, requiring a Fortitude save or death from fear. Even on a successful Fortitude save, the subject takes 3d6 damage.

Phantom Steed.description: You conjure a Large quasi-real horse ridden only by you or a designated person. AC 18, 7 + 1 per CL hit points. Speed: 20 feet per caster level (maximum 240). Carries rider plus 10 lbs per CL. Gains abilities at higher levels: 8th (ignores difficult terrain), 10th (water walk), 12th (air walk for 1 round), 14th (fly at speed with average maneuverability).

Phase Door.description: You create an invisible ethereal passage through wood, plaster, or stone (not other materials). Only you can use it (one Medium companion per use counts as two uses). It blocks light, sound, and spells. A gem of true seeing reveals but does not enable use. Subject to dispel magic (safe ejection). You can set triggering conditions for others. Can be made permanent with permanency.

Planar Ally.description: This functions like lesser planar ally, except you may call one creature of 12 HD or less, or two creatures totaling 12 HD. XP Cost: 250 XP.

Planar Ally, Greater.description: This functions like lesser planar ally, except you may call one creature of 18 HD or less, or up to three totaling 18 HD. XP Cost: 500 XP.

Planar Ally, Lesser.description: You request your deity to send a creature of 6 HD or less. You must communicate to negotiate services in exchange for payment (100 gp/HD for up to 1 minute/level, 500 gp/HD for 1 hour/level, 1,000 gp/HD for 1 day/level). Nonhazardous tasks are half price; strongly aligned tasks may be discounted. XP Cost: 100 XP.

Planar Binding.description: This functions like lesser planar binding, except you may call one creature of 12 HD or less, or up to three totaling 12 HD. Each saves, escapes, and is persuaded independently.

Planar Binding, Greater.description: This functions like lesser planar binding, except you may call one creature of 18 HD or less, or up to three totaling 18 HD.

Planar Binding, Lesser.description: You lure an extraplanar creature into a magic circle trap. The target gets a Will save; failure draws it in. It can attempt daily escape via spell resistance, dimensional travel, or Charisma check (DC 15 + half your CL + your Cha mod). You must persuade it to perform a service via opposed Charisma checks (GM assigns +0 to +6 bonus). Impossible demands are refused. Rolling a 1 frees the creature.

Plane Shift.description: You transport yourself and up to eight linked willing creatures to another plane, arriving 5 to 500 miles from your intended destination. Focus: A small forked metal rod keyed to the destination plane.

Plant Growth.description: Two versions. Overgrowth: Normal vegetation becomes thick and overgrown, reducing speed to 5 feet (10 for Large+). Enrichment: Plants within half a mile increase productivity by one-third over the next year. Counters diminish plants. Does not affect plant creatures.

Poison.description: A melee touch attack infects the target, dealing 1d10 temporary Constitution damage immediately and another 1d10 one minute later. Each instance allows a Fortitude save (DC 10 + half CL + Wis modifier).

Polar Ray.description: A blue-white ray of freezing air (ranged touch attack) deals 1d6 cold per caster level (maximum 25d6). Focus: A small white ceramic cone or prism.

Polymorph.description: This functions like alter self, except you change a willing subject into another living creature form of various types. Maximum HD equals the lesser of your CL or the subject's HD (up to 15). The subject gains the new form's Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution but keeps its mental scores. It gains extraordinary special attacks but not extraordinary special qualities, supernatural abilities, or spell-like abilities. It regains hp as if resting when transformed. Material Component: An empty cocoon.

Polymorph Any Object.description: This functions like polymorph, except it can change objects or creatures. Duration depends on the degree of change. Unlike polymorph, it grants the new form's Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma if the original lacked them. Cannot create valuable materials, magic items, or cold iron. Can duplicate the effects of several specific transmutation spells. Arcane Material Component: Mercury, gum arabic, and smoke.

Power Word Blind.description: A single word of power blinds one creature regardless of whether it can hear. Duration depends on current hit points. Creatures with 201+ hp are unaffected.

Power Word Kill.description: A single word of power instantly kills one creature regardless of whether it can hear. Creatures with 101+ hp are unaffected.

Power Word Stun.description: A single word of power stuns one creature regardless of whether it can hear. Duration depends on current hit points. Creatures with 151+ hp are unaffected.

Prayer.description: You and your allies gain +1 luck bonus on attack rolls, weapon damage, saves, and skill checks, while each foe takes a -1 penalty on the same.

Prestidigitation.description: Minor magical tricks lasting 1 hour: slowly lift 1 pound, color/clean/soil 1-foot cube per round, chill/warm/flavor 1 pound of nonliving material. Cannot deal damage or affect concentration. Created objects are crude, fragile, and cannot serve as tools, weapons, or components. Actual changes (beyond moving/cleaning/soiling) persist only 1 hour.

Prismatic Sphere.description: This functions like prismatic wall, except it forms an immobile opaque globe surrounding you. Blinds creatures with less than 8 HD for 2d4x10 minutes. You can pass freely. It blocks outgoing projections. Creatures passing through suffer each color's effect. Can be made permanent with permanency.

Prismatic Spray.description: Seven multicolored beams spray from your hand. Creatures with 8 HD or less are blinded for 2d4 rounds. Each creature is randomly struck by one or more beams, each with different effects.

Prismatic Wall.description: An immobile, vertical, multicolored wall protects you. Creatures with less than 8 HD within 20 feet are blinded for 2d4 rounds. Each of seven colors has a distinct effect on creatures attempting to pass. Colors must be destroyed in order by specific magic. A rod of cancellation or disjunction destroys it entirely. Antimagic fields cannot penetrate it. Spell resistance must be checked per color. Can be made permanent with permanency.

Produce Flame.description: Flames appear in your open hand, providing torch illumination and dealing 1d6 + 1 per caster level (maximum +5) fire damage via melee touch or ranged touch (120 feet, no range penalty). Each attack reduces duration by 1 minute. Does not function underwater.

Programmed Image.description: This functions like silent image, except it includes all sensory elements and activates on a specified trigger condition. The trigger must be based on sensory input, not intangible qualities. Material Component: Fleece and jade dust (25 gp).

Project Image.description: You create a quasi-real illusory copy of yourself using shadow energy. It looks, sounds, and smells like you but is intangible. It mimics your actions unless directed otherwise (move action). You can see and hear through it (your body is blinded and deafened while doing so). Touch-or-greater range spells can originate from it. Objects treat it as if they saved. Line of effect must be maintained; breaking it ends the spell. Material Component: A small replica of yourself (5 gp).

Protection from Arrows.description: The subject gains DR 10/magic against ranged weapons until the spell absorbs 10 points per caster level (maximum 100). Focus: A tortoise or turtle shell piece.

Protection from Chaos.description: This functions like protection from evil, except bonuses apply against chaotic creatures and chaotic summoned creatures cannot touch the subject.

Protection from Energy.description: Grants temporary immunity to one energy type (acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic). Absorbs 12 points per caster level (maximum 120). Overlaps (does not stack) with resist energy.

Protection from Evil.description: Wards the subject with three effects: +2 deflection to AC and +2 resistance on saves against evil creatures; blocks possession and ongoing mental control by evil creatures (suppresses but does not dispel); prevents bodily contact by evil summoned creatures (good summoned creatures are exempt). The protection against summoned creatures ends if the subject attacks. Arcane Material Component: Powdered silver for a 3-foot circle.

Protection from Good.description: This functions like protection from evil, except bonuses apply against good creatures and good summoned creatures cannot touch the subject.

Protection from Law.description: This functions like protection from evil, except bonuses apply against lawful creatures and lawful summoned creatures cannot touch the subject.

Protection from Spells.description: Subjects gain a +8 resistance bonus on saves against spells and spell-like abilities (not supernatural or extraordinary). Material Component: A diamond worth at least 500 gp, crushed over the targets. Focus: One 1,000 gp diamond per creature, which must be carried.

Prying Eyes.description: You create 1d4 + caster level semi-tangible magical eyes (Fine constructs, 1 hp, AC 18, fly 30 ft perfect, +16 Hide, Spot = caster level max +15). You give them instructions (25 words max). Eyes scout within 1 mile and return to replay their recordings (1 round per hour). Each eye sees 120 feet (normal vision). Dispel magic can destroy them. Material Component: Crystal marbles.

Prying Eyes, Greater.description: This functions like prying eyes, except the eyes have true seeing (120-foot range) and maximum Spot modifier of +25.

Purify Food and Drink.description: You make spoiled, poisonous, or contaminated food and water safe to consume. Does not prevent subsequent spoilage. Spoils unholy water but does not affect creatures or potions.

Pyrotechnics.description: You transform a fire into either fireworks (blinding creatures within 120 feet for 1d4+1 rounds, Will negates, requires line of sight, SR applies) or a smoke cloud (20-foot spread, blocks all sight, -4 Strength and Dexterity for 1d4+1 rounds after leaving, Fortitude negates, SR does not apply). The fire source is extinguished.

Quench.description: Extinguishes nonmagical fires and can dispel fire spells (dispel check: 1d20 + 1/level, max +15, DC 11 + fire spell CL). Fire elementals take 1d6 per caster level (max 15d6, no save). Alternatively, targeting a single fire magic item suppresses its fire abilities for 1d4 hours (Will negates; artifacts immune).

Rage.description: Subjects gain +2 morale bonus to Strength and Constitution, +1 on Will saves, and -2 to AC. Functions like barbarian rage except subjects are not fatigued afterward.

Rainbow Pattern.description: A glowing pattern fascinates up to 24 HD of creatures (fewest HD first). With a free action, you can move the pattern 30 feet per round; fascinated creatures follow. A second save is allowed when led into danger. Blocked sight ends the effect. Sightless creatures are unaffected. Material Component: Phosphor. Focus: Crystal prism.

Raise Dead.description: You restore a creature dead no longer than one day per caster level. The soul must be free and willing. The subject loses one level (or 2 Constitution if 1st level; if this would reduce Con to 0, it cannot be raised). Lost spells have a 50% chance of being lost. The raised creature has hp equal to its current HD. Ability scores at 0 are raised to 1. Mundane poison and disease are cured; magical ones are not. The body must be whole. Cannot raise undead, death-effect victims, constructs, elementals, outsiders, or those dead of old age. Material Component: Diamonds worth at least 5,000 gp.

Rary's Mnemonic Enhancer.description: Two versions. Prepare: Prepare up to three additional spell levels (cantrips count as half). Retain: Restore a spell of 3rd level or lower cast within the previous round. Prepared or retained spells fade after 24 hours. Material Component: String, and ink of squid secretion with black dragon's blood. Focus: An ivory plaque (50 gp).

Rary's Telepathic Bond.description: You forge a telepathic link among yourself and willing creatures (Intelligence 3+). All linked creatures communicate telepathically regardless of language. Works over any distance on the same plane. You may exclude yourself. Can be made permanent with permanency (bonding two creatures per casting). Material Component: Eggshell from two different creatures.

Ray of Enfeeblement.description: A ray (ranged touch attack) imposes a Strength penalty of 1d6 + 1 per two caster levels (maximum 1d6+5). Cannot reduce Strength below 1.

Ray of Exhaustion.description: A black ray (ranged touch attack) exhausts the target (Fortitude save for fatigued only). Already fatigued targets become exhausted. No effect on already exhausted targets. The condition ends when the spell expires. Material Component: A drop of sweat.

Ray of Frost.description: A ray of freezing air (ranged touch attack) deals 1d3 cold damage.

Read Magic.description: You decipher magical inscriptions that would otherwise be unintelligible. This does not normally activate the magic (except cursed scrolls). After reading, you can thereafter read that writing without the spell. Identifies glyphs of warding (DC 13 Spellcraft), greater glyphs (DC 16), and symbol spells (DC 10 + spell level). Can be made permanent with permanency. Focus: A clear crystal or mineral prism.

Reduce Animal.description: This functions like reduce person, except it affects a single willing animal.

Reduce Person.description: A humanoid halves in height, length, and width, dividing weight by 8 and dropping one size category. The target gains +2 Dexterity, -2 Strength (minimum 1), and +1 on attacks and AC. Equipment shrinks accordingly; weapons deal less damage. Multiple size-reducing effects do not stack. Counters and dispels enlarge person. Can be made permanent. Material Component: Powdered iron.

Reduce Person, Mass.description: This functions like reduce person, except it affects multiple creatures.

Refuge.description: You enchant a specially prepared object that, when broken while speaking a command word, instantly transports the possessor to your abode (or you to the possessor's location, if you choose that variant at casting). Material Component: The prepared object with gems worth 1,500 gp.

Regenerate.description: Severed members, broken bones, and ruined organs regrow. Regeneration completes in 1 round if severed parts are touching the creature, or 2d10 rounds otherwise. Also heals 4d8 + 1 per caster level (maximum +35), eliminates exhaustion, fatigue, and all nonlethal damage. No effect on nonliving creatures including undead.

Reincarnate.description: You return a creature dead no more than one week to life in a new body. The soul must be free and willing. Physical ills are repaired; only a small body portion is needed.
